   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Since a significant portion of the total operating expense for Retail and Office/Industrial are recouped as part of recovery revenue, the CODM looks at NOI as a whole when reviewing the segments.&#160;For the Model Home segment, the properties are leased on a triple net basis and the tenants are responsible for a significant portion of the operating expenses.&#160;Therefore, the CODM focuses on Model Home revenue, any impairments and the gain on sale of model homes.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The CODM reviews on a regular basis the GAAP performance of each segment, including the significant segment expenses reported for GAAP shown in the table below. Our significant segment expenses include consolidated expense categories presented in our consolidated statements of operations, as well as rental operating costs.&#160;This information is provided to the CODM and factors into the CODM&#8217;s decision making for company-wide strategy. The following tables compare the Company&#8217;s segment activity and&#160;to its results of GAAP operations and financial position as of and for the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, respectively.&#160;The information for Corporate and Other are presented to reconcile back to the consolidated statement of operations, but is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> considered a reportable segment as noted above.</p>

  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock" id="c3148015" escape="true">
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">14.</em>&#160;INCOME TAX PROVISION</b></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-align: justify;">The Company is operated as, and has elected to be taxed as, a REIT under Sections <em style="font: inherit;">856</em> to <em style="font: inherit;">860</em> of the Code. As a REIT, the Company is generally <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> subject to corporate level income taxes on REIT taxable income that is distributed to its shareholders. The Company accounts for income taxes under the asset and liability method under which it recognizes deferred income taxes, net of valuation allowances, if any, for the estimated future tax effects of temporary differences between the financial statement carrying amounts of existing assets and liabilities and its tax bases and net operating loss and tax credit carryforwards. The Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may, </em>from time to time, be assessed interest or penalties by tax jurisdictions, although any such assessments historically have been minimal and immaterial to its financial results. In the event the Company has such an assessment from a taxing authority, it is its accounting policy to recognize any interest and penalties as a component of income tax. We, together with <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> of our entities, have elected to treat certain subsidiaries as a taxable REIT subsidiary (a &#8220;TRS&#8221;) for federal income tax purposes. Certain activities that we undertake must be conducted by a TRS, such as non-customary services for our tenants, and holding assets that we cannot hold directly. A TRS is subject to federal and state income taxes. The Company has concluded that there are <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> significant uncertain tax positions requiring recognition in its financial statements. Neither the Company nor its subsidiaries have been assessed any significant interest or penalties for tax positions by any tax jurisdictions.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -36pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-align: justify;">Deferred tax assets and liabilities are measured using enacted tax rates expected to apply to taxable income in the years in which those temporary differences are expected to be recovered or settled. The effect on deferred tax assets and liabilities of a change in tax rates is recognized in income in the period that includes the enactment date.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em>the Company had net operating loss carryforwards of $<ix:nonFraction id="c142559177" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">321,111</ix:nonFraction> for federal, $<ix:nonFraction id="c142559178" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">36,361</ix:nonFraction> for state income tax purposes. The Company's state loss carryforwards will begin to expire starting in <em style="font: inherit;">2041</em> if <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> utilized.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Management assessed the available positive and negative evidence to estimate whether sufficient future taxable income will be generated to permit use of the existing deferred tax assets. A significant piece of objective positive evidence evaluated was the history of cumulative income for Model Homes Inc. incurred over the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>-year period ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025. </em>Such objective evidence provides support for <ix:nonFraction id="c142559182" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">no</ix:nonFraction> valuation allowance to be recorded for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> December 2023, </em>the FASB issued ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09,</em> Income Taxes (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">740</em>): Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures, which improves income tax disclosures through enhanced disaggregation within the rate reconciliation table and disaggregation of income taxes paid by jurisdiction. The amendment is effective for fiscal years beginning after <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2024 </em>and early adoption is permitted. The amendments should be applied on a prospective basis, however, retrospective application is permitted. The adoption of this ASU only impacted disclosures with <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> impact on the Company's consolidated financial statements.</p>

This payment was for purchasing <ix:nonFraction id="c142559220" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-BoardOfDirectorMember_StatementClassOfStockAxis-CommonClassAMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodShares" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">18,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of SQFT stock from Jim Durfey</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">16.</em>&#160;SUBSEQUENT EVENTS</b></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <div style="font-size:10pt">
    <div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; text-align: justify;">
      The Company evaluated subsequent events and transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued. Based upon this review, except as disclosed below, the Company did
     <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> identify any subsequent events that would have required adjustment or disclosure in the financial statements other than disclosed below.

    <div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; text-align: justify;">
     <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -2pt;">The Board of Directors has suspended the Company&#8217;s monthly dividend on its <ix:nonFraction id="c142559223" contextRef="d_2026-01-28_2026-01-28_StatementClassOfStockAxis-SeriesDPreferredStockMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="5">9.375</ix:nonFraction>% Series D Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock, commencing with the <em style="font: inherit;"> January 2026 </em>monthly dividend that would have been paid on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 15, 2026. </em>In accordance with the terms of the Series D Preferred Stock, the unpaid monthly dividends will continue to accrue at $<ix:nonFraction id="c142559224" contextRef="d_2026-01-28_2026-01-28_StatementClassOfStockAxis-SeriesDPreferredStockMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendRatePerDollarAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">0.19531</ix:nonFraction> per share each month.&#160;The Company estimates that suspension of the dividend will preserve approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c142559225" contextRef="d_2026-01-28_2026-01-28_StatementClassOfStockAxis-SeriesDPreferredStockMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="sqft:PreferredStockYearlyCashSavingsFromDividendsSuspension" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">2.3</ix:nonFraction> million in cash on an annualized basis. The Board and the Company intend to reassess, on a quarterly basis, when accrued dividends on the Series D Preferred Stock <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be paid and when the monthly dividend payments can be reinstated.</p>
     <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
     <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> January 21, 2026, </em>the Company received a notice that the Company's failure to repay in full by <em style="font: inherit;"> January 5, 2026 </em>the indebtedness owed under that certain promissory note dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 24, 2015 </em>issued to The Bancorp Bank in the original principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c142559226" contextRef="i_2015-12-24_DebtInstrumentAxis-PromissoryNoteMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-BancorpBankMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">17,727,500</ix:nonFraction>, the related loan agreement, dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 24, 2015 </em>by and between the Company and Bancorp Bank.&#160;The Company has received notification that the Shea Center II property governed by this agreement will be moved into receivership, which will fulfill its obligation for this non-recourse loan.</p>
